notes.title: Patch Notes (16.10.1)
notes.content:
Fixed bug related to unlocking bags
 Added visual indicators for number of letters for swapped tiles

notes.title: Patch Notes (16.9.1)
notes.content:
[olist]
 Fixed discards when using inverted discards with no letters selected
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes (16..8.2)
notes.content: Bug fix related to power scale.

notes.title: Patch Notes (16.8.1)
notes.content:
Added power scale which requires additional points based on number of gems used
 Fixed various bugs

notes.title: Patch Notes (16.7.1)
notes.content:
Fixed bugs related to final gambit when inverted discard is selected
 Fixed bugs related to inverted discards causing point miscalculations
 Fixed bug related to word upgrade bonuses resetting
 Added different saves for Upgrades per profile

notes.title: Patch Notes (16.6.1)
notes.content:
[olist]
 Increased the speed of acquiring gems in the early levels. The total number of gems per run has stayed around the same amount. 
 Daily challenges are now available without logging in. Submitting a score still requires an account.
 Fixed a bug related to counting word and letter upgrades for unlocks
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes (16.5.1)
notes.content:
Wilds are automatically used when playing with the keyboard. The default way of using Wilds still works as normal.  
 Added setting to invert discards (i.e., you keep your selected inputs / words when discarding) 
 Updated Upgrades to provide additional options costing less gems for early progression

notes.title: Patch Notes (16.4.1)
notes.content: Fixed bug regarding Marble tile upgrades and resetting/discarding tiles

notes.title: Patch Notes (16.3.8)
notes.content:
Fixed bug related to controller selection for rewards
 Fixed tooltip for upgraded tiles using the controller
